source: It takes great effort to build an aviary from nothing. A labor of blind will. Foolhardy aspirations.  In the spring season, Nav’ed and his followers built a crude stone corral and pine coop for roadrunners, and then needed another two seasons to trap two healthy adult breeding pairs. Three Quentinites were assigned the delicate task of creating and maintaining a mealworm farm for bird food. All the feeding had to be done with as little hand-rearing as possible, so as to avoid creating dependencies from the birds onto their human breeders. The first many chicks died in the winter months from lack of heat and local thieves, but enough survived to maintain the aviary with bare minimum genetic diversity. Across the frigid season, dozens of small maps were etched onto tanned rat skins – ways to local waterholes and landmarks leading to Obark from all directions. By the coming fall, the first three roadrunners were released, maps strapped to their feathery backs. A few Quentinites scratched their heads as they watched years of planning, struggle, and effort disappear into the horizon in a little cloud of dust.
target: 从无到有建立鸟舍，得付出极大心力。盲目意志的苦工。近乎愚勇的抱负。春季，纳维德与追随者为走鹃筑起简陋的石围栏与松木鸟舍，接着又花了两季，才捕到两对健康、可供繁殖的成鸟。三位昆汀修士受命负责细腻的工作：建立并维持黄粉虫养殖场，作为鸟食。喂养时必须尽量减少亲手照料，避免鸟儿依赖人类饲养者。最初许多雏鸟在冬季因缺乏暖意或遭当地窃贼偷走而丧命，但仍有足够数量存活，勉强维持鸟舍最低限度的基因多样性。寒季里，数十张小地图被刻在鞣制鼠皮上——标出当地水源，以及从各方向通往欧巴克的地标。隔年秋天，首批三只走鹃背负地图，获得释放。几位昆汀修士搔着头，看着多年计划、奋斗与心血，化成小小尘云，消失在地平线。

source: BORN TO RUN
target: 生来奔跑

source: Mama Lulu was the first roadrunner trapped and successfully domesticated for breeding by the Quentinites, and breed she did. A calm, satisfied bird, she seemed grateful for the protection of the coop and the consistency of the feed. Her eggs appeared during the usual nesting time of spring, but she often delivered a second brood in late summer – a sign of a happy hen. All of the Quentinites revered her serenity. Countless nights were spent pondering and discussing the paradox of being trapped and happy. When Obark warriors brought destruction to the aviary, Mama Lulu was the first and only bird to have her neck snapped by a Quentinite’s hand.
target: 露露妈妈是昆汀修士第一只捕获、成功驯养供繁殖的走鹃，而牠确实生了不少。牠平静而满足，似乎很感激鸟舍的庇护与稳定供应的食物。牠在寻常的春季筑巢期下蛋，却常在夏末再生一窝——这是母鸟过得愉快的征兆。所有昆汀修士都敬重牠的安宁。无数夜晚，他们思索、讨论着受困却快乐的矛盾。欧巴克战士摧毁鸟舍时，露露妈妈成了第一只，也是唯一一只，被昆汀修士亲手扭断脖子的鸟。

source: MAMA LULU
target: 露露妈妈

source: ROADS ETERNAL
target: 永恒道路

source: Great roads last as long as mountains. Along the ancient highways blazed by a “Cal Holt,” extending in the four cardinal directions, the shallow sea eroded ruts and potholes into great sinkholes. Dirty pools grew small oases for wildlife and travelers, and became common camps for roving bandits. Later on, Massuma Empire cartographers plotted these waterholes to aid the movement and resupply of the snail legions. Accurate maps meant efficient territorial expansion. A century later, this work formed the foundation for the mighty trade corridors of Quent.
target: 伟大的道路，与山脉同样长久。一位「卡尔・霍特」开辟的古代公路，向东西南北延伸；浅海沿路侵蚀，将车辙与坑洞变成巨大陷穴。污浊水池成了野生动物与旅人的小绿洲，也成为流窜盗匪常用的营地。后来，马苏玛帝国的制图师标出这些水源，协助蜗牛军团行军与补给。精确地图意味着高效率的领土扩张。一个世纪后，这项工作成了昆特强盛贸易走廊的基础。

source: Quent engineers were stunned at the amount of crude brick emerging from this spring’s excavation near the base of their Mt. Vivienne. Who cared to make so many? How? When? And most mysteriously, why spread it across the earth? Exomnus Archaeologists arrived to examine the odd findings, pored over shelves of ancient texts to find a past purpose, but were unable to offer more than shrug. All agreed, however, that had it not been for these strange bricks, the dust and heat of the dry era would have sapped the earth of this immense reservoir of groundwater formed centuries ago from the great shallow sea. To learned people, the most frustrating conclusion of all is one that nods to luck.
target: 今年春天，昆特工程师在薇薇安山脚附近挖掘，为出土的大量粗砖震惊不已。谁费心做了这么多？怎么做的？何时做的？最神秘的是，为什么要把它们铺满大地？艾克索姆考古学者前来检视奇特发现，翻遍一架架古籍，寻找昔日用途，最后却只能耸肩。然而，所有人都同意：要不是这些怪砖，干旱时代的尘土与高热，早已耗尽这座巨大地下水库——那是几百年前广大浅海留下的水。对学识渊博的人而言，最令人挫折的结论，莫过于归功运气。

source: SEALED SEA
target: 封存的海

source: H2GO
target: 水到渠成

source: Water is life. The expansive underground reservoir gurgling to the surface gives Quent an explosion of sustenance – the city rapidly irrigates farms, builds homes, and lays infrastructure to accommodate more and more migrants. The dirty, squabbling masses at the gates are cleaned, clothed, fed, and sheltered so they can focus on learning. Those that refuse to break from violence and barbarism are given a sack of food and a map of the Great Waterhole Roads. But the great many are eager to contribute to the symbiosis of the community. In turn, the community creates more positive energy than it consumes, much like nuclear fusion, which is expected to be harnessed in a matter of years.
target: 水就是生命。广大的地下水库汩汩涌上地表，为昆特带来暴增的生存资源——城市迅速灌溉农田、兴建家园、铺设基础设施，接纳愈来愈多移民。城门口脏污、争吵的人群，得到清洗、衣物、食物与住处，得以专注学习。不肯放下暴力与野蛮的人，会得到一袋食物及大水源道地图。然而，大多数人热切希望为社区的共生出力。社区因而产生比消耗更多的正面能量，如同预计数年内便能掌握的核融合。

source: FAMILIAR WILD
target: 熟悉的荒野

source: Slingshots, seasoned jerkies, antler-handled knives, magnifying glasses, quills and colored inks, long-necked pipes, leather-bound books, fur hats, dry bundles of lavender, potted herbs, jugs of honeyed mead, and shelves with whittled figurines of boars and bears – the cabin of a man who cultivates nature and the simple joys it offers. A deep woods home for listening to the whispers of the wind and mind. A place that bridges the depths of the wild with the wisdom to gently shape it. How inviting for a lost, nervous child who is curious to learn about the world.
target: 弹弓、调味肉干、鹿角柄刀、放大镜、羽毛笔与彩色墨水、长颈烟斗、皮封书籍、毛皮帽、干燥薰衣草束、盆栽药草、成罐蜂蜜酒，以及架上削成野猪与熊的小木像——这间小屋的主人，培育自然，也培育自然带来的单纯喜悦。一个深林中的家，倾听风与心的低语。一个连结荒野深处，与温柔塑造荒野之智慧的地方。对一个迷途、紧张、渴望认识世界的孩子，这会是多么亲切的所在。

source: When does trash quickly become treasure? When you add the catalyst of human desperation. A dozen miles off of Route 25, swaths of seagulls swirl and caw over the township’s trash dump that spans 10 football fields. Without a vehicle, it takes Pinies a whole day to make the journey to and from this pit of rot and gas and, once there, all sorts of hungry and cruel people may be fighting over the waste. Not to mention the packs of stray dogs. And yet, locals take the risk. They cannot let go of their past ways of life. Batteries for their devices, modern clothing, pre-made containers, motor oils, electrical cords, modern cookware…. They refuse to let go.
target: 垃圾什么时候会迅速变成宝藏？加入人类绝望这个催化剂时。离二十五号公路十二英里外，成群海鸥在镇公所垃圾场上空盘旋啼叫，那片垃圾场足有十座足球场大。没有交通工具，松林镇民得花整整一天，才能往返这处腐败与气体充斥的深坑；到了那里，又可能遇上各种饥饿、残酷的人争夺废物。更别说成群流浪狗。然而，当地人仍甘冒风险。他们放不下昔日的生活方式。装置用的电池、现代衣物、现成容器、机油、电线、现代厨具……他们拒绝放手。

source: BURIED TREASURES
target: 掩埋的宝藏

source: Pinies who show a lack of faith in Jehova Jim and his vision are deemed PJ’s – “philistine junkers.” On good days, they’re driven out to the dump and given wrenches to gather lug nuts, engine belts, injection pumps, and sheet metal for armoring. On bad days, they’re given picks and shovels to unearth buried drums of toxic sludge in hopes of finding a container of diesel waste. It’s never the work that kills PJ’s. They’re taken by infections from the lacerations and wounds caused by clambering around this jagged, caustic environment.
target: 对耶和华吉姆及其愿景缺乏信仰的松林镇民，被归为 PJ——「俗民拾荒者」。运气好时，他们被押到垃圾场，拿着扳手收集轮帽、引擎皮带、喷射泵，以及用来加装装甲的金属板。运气差时，他们拿到十字镐与铲子，挖掘埋在地下的有毒污泥桶，希望找到一桶废柴油。杀死 PJ 的，从来不是工作本身。在这个尖锐、腐蚀性的环境中攀爬造成的割裂伤与伤口，引发感染，夺走他们的命。

source: PHILISTINE JUNKERS
target: 俗民拾荒者

source: PREPPERS
target: 末日准备者

source: About 26% of suburban adults identified as preppers leading into the great collapse from Worm83. They carefully allotted their time and wealth to stockpile, fortify, and prepare for anticipated threats. Relaxed and comfortable, they ordered bunkers from the internet, shopping for ones that appealed to their particular tastes for kitchen, bath, or greenhouse amenities. Further beyond town, in wooded cabins and the off-grid trailer parks, a much smaller group of intensely dedicated people identified as survivalists. These were the mental preppers, focused on honing skills that make them adaptable to a variety of situations. Unfortunately for the families in their subterranean cages, the rugged survivalists had already imagined killing them. Because they understood the nature of survival: it’s never a matter of choice, but of need.
target: 蠕虫83 引发大崩溃之前，约有百分之二十六的郊区成年人自认是末日准备者。他们仔细分配时间与财富，囤积物资、加固设施，为预想的威胁做准备。他们悠闲舒适地上网订购碉堡，挑选符合自己厨房、浴室或温室设备喜好的款式。更远的镇外，在林间小屋与离网拖车营地里，另一小群极度投入的人自称求生主义者。他们做的是心理准备，专注磨练能适应各种处境的技能。不幸的是，对那些住在地下牢笼的家庭而言，这些强悍的求生者早已想过杀死他们。因为他们懂得生存的本质：从来不是选择，而是需要。

source: CONTROLLED BURN
target: 控制性焚烧

source: Sometimes a farmer chooses to burn their field to drive out an infestation of disease-carrying rodents. Better to kill the crop and the vermin with it than to let the problem spread. Every Monday and Thursday, a small group of armed Pinies leave Fort Asbury and burn a few abandoned suburban homes in the sprawl around them. Better to destroy these structures than to let scavengers and raiders use them for shelter and  concealment.
target: 有时，农人选择烧掉田地，赶走肆虐、带病的啮齿动物。宁可连作物与害兽一起烧毁，也不要任问题蔓延。每逢星期一与星期四，一小队武装松林镇民离开阿斯伯里堡，烧掉周围蔓延郊区中的几栋废弃住宅。宁可摧毁这些建筑，也不要让拾荒者与掠夺者用来栖身、藏匿。
